newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark deplores Chinese dissident's sentence.
newsitem.headline: Denmark deplores Chinese dissident's sentence.

text.p: Denmark urged China on Tuesday to reconsider an 11-year prison term on democracy activist Wang Dan, a leader of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, who was convicted this week of plotting to subvert the government.
"The stiff sentence delivered on the dissident Wang Dan causes us great concern," Foreign Minister Niels Helveg Petersen said in a statement.

"It is deplorable that the Chinese authorities continue to persecute the leader of the pro-democracy demonstrations in 1989 because of his critical stance. Along with other nations, Denmark hopes that the sentence can be changed," he said.
"The case clearly shows that China still has major problems with human rights. There is a great need for an open dialogue in this field," Petersen concluded.
Wang, 27, was sentenced to 11 years in prison on Wednesday after a brief hearing.
